resources.string: Choose how Sidequest looks without changing how it works.
Protect this device and confirm what stays local.
Control whether Sidequest can surface reminder prompts on this device.
Choose where notes are mirrored and how you move data between devices.
Optional remote analysis. Leave everything off if you want to stay local-only.
Quick checks when capture, reminders, or unlock flow feel off.
This changes the palette only. Your layout and workflow stay the same.
Keep local Sidequest data behind the same lock flow you trust on this phone.
Your Sidequest data stays on this device unless you connect a notes folder or turn on an AI provider.
Require Face ID, fingerprint, or your device credential before Sidequest opens.
Let Sidequest deliver reminder alerts and follow-up prompts on this device.
Notifications are available, so scheduled reminders can surface outside the app.
Without notification access, reminders stay in Sidequest and will not appear as system alerts.
Optionally mirror markdown notes into a folder you choose.
When connected, Sidequest writes note files and linked capture images into that folder. Disconnecting stops future writes there but does not delete files already created.
Create a manual snapshot or restore one you exported earlier.
A snapshot includes your local captures, missions, notes, routines, shopping lists, and search index on this device.
Restoring a snapshot replaces the current local Sidequest data on this device with the contents of that file.
Use this only if you want remote help with capture analysis.
When a provider is active, eligible captures can send the image and OCR text needed to generate mission, date, reference, or fact suggestions.
Sidequest still works locally with on-device OCR and manual review.
Loading the locally configured provider keys and availability on this device.
Retry the provider check. Until then, capture stays local-only.
Operational checks for the core Sidequest flows on this device.
Only one AI provider can be active at a time. Saved keys stay on this device even when a provider is turned off.
%1$s currently handles AI analysis for eligible captures. New AI-assisted scans can send the required image and OCR text there.
Turn this on when you want eligible captures sent to %1$s for AI analysis.
Add a key first if you want to use %1$s. Until then, Sidequest stays local-only.
Paste a new key here. Saving replaces the existing key on this device only.
A key is already saved on this device. Sidequest hides most of it after saving.
No key is saved for %1$s yet.
The notes folder could not be saved.
Notes folder disconnected. Existing exported files stay where they are.
The notes folder could not be disconnected.
Add an API key first, or leave this provider off.
AI analysis turned off. New captures stay local-only unless you switch it back on.
%1$s is now active for AI analysis on eligible captures.
The provider setting could not be updated.
The AI provider status could not be loaded.
The snapshot could not be exported.
The snapshot could not be restored.
